text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Nuclear Safety AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × ONR MOD Defence Nuclear Safety AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK MOD defence nuclear safety — ONR oversight, AWE operations, submarine reactor safety, nuclear waste management, Trident programme safety cases, defence nuclear environmental remediation. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points ONR ONR Regulation — Defence Nuclear Licensing, Safety Assessments Office for Nuclear Regulation (ONR) oversees defence nuclear activities under Nuclear Installations Act 1965. Site licence conditions for AWE Aldermaston, Burghfield, Devonport, Raynesway. Safety assessment principles, fundamental safety objectives, emergency preparedness. Licence compliance inspections. Enforcement — improvement and prohibition notices. Annual report to Parliament. IAEA bilateral cooperation. ONR defence programme directorate. AWE AWE Operations — Aldermaston, Burghfield, Warhead Manufacturing Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE plc) — design, manufacture, and maintenance of UK nuclear warheads. Aldermaston: warhead design, physics, hydrodynamics, materials science. Burghfield: warhead assembly, disassembly, refurbishment. AWE licence conditions: criticality safety, radiation protection, conventional safety. INF Treaty compliance. Warhead life-extension programme. Trident Holbrook warhead. High Explosive Research facility. Orion laser facility. Environmental permits. Decommissioning liabilities. Workforce of ~5,000. Reactors Submarine Reactor Safety — PWR2/PWR3, Naval Reactor Operations Pressurised Water Reactor (PWR) designs for Royal Navy submarines. PWR2 for Vanguard-class (Trident) and Trafalgar-class. PWR3 for Astute-class and Dreadnought-class. Rolls-Royce Marine: reactor design, manufacture, fuel fabrication at Raynesway. Naval reactor safety case methodology. Reactor compartment shielding. Primary and secondary coolant circuits. Emergency reactor shutdown (SCRAM). Reactor coolant leak detection. Submarine decommissioning — reactor defueling, storage at Devonport. Nuclear propulsion safety. Naval nuclear fuel cycle. Waste Nuclear Waste Management — LLW, ILW, Spent Fuel, Decommissioning Defence nuclear waste classification: Low Level Waste (LLW), Intermediate Level Waste (ILW), High Level Waste (HLW), spent fuel. AWE waste streams: contaminated metals, HE residues, liquid effluent. Submarine decommissioning waste: reactor components, contaminated steel. ILW stores at AWE, Devonport, Rosyth. Spent naval fuel reprocessing at Sellafield. Waste packaging, conditioning, interim storage. UK Radioactive Waste Inventory. Geological Disposal Facility (GDF) — long-term disposal strategy. Defence waste NDA strategy. Waste acceptance criteria. Safety Cases Safety Case Management — Periodic Safety Reviews, ALARP Demonstrations Defence nuclear safety case regime: safety cases, hazard identification, fault analysis, consequence assessment. ALARP demonstration methodology. Periodic Safety Reviews — 10-year cycle. Deterministic and probabilistic safety assessment. Common cause failure analysis. Human reliability assessment. Safety case review by ONR inspectors. Change management. Design Assessment and Pre-construction Safety Report (PCSR). Defence Nuclear Safety Committee (DNSC) oversight. Emergency Emergency Planning — REPPIR, Off-Site Emergency Plans, JESIP REPPIR 2019 compliance. Off-site emergency plans — AWE, Devonport, Coulport. Emergency Planning Zones. JESIP multi-agency response. UKHSA radiation monitoring. Local Authority off-site plans. MOD emergency liaison. COBR coordination. CONTEST counter-terrorism. Regular emergency exercises. IAEA Early Notification Convention. Transport Nuclear Transport — Flask Movements, Route Approvals,
